meta.name: init-onecli
meta.description: Install and initialize OneCLI Agent Vault. Migrates existing .env credentials to the vault. Use after /update-nanoclaw brings in OneCLI as a breaking change, or for first-time OneCLI setup.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 初始化 OneCLI 凭证库并迁移环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚安装 OneCLI 或需要将 .env 凭证迁移到安全库
copy.tagline_en: Initialize OneCLI credential vault and migrate environment variables
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just installed OneCLI or need to migrate .env credentials to the vault

howto.what: Claude 会安装 OneCLI、配置 Agent Vault 网关,并把 .env 里的 API 密钥迁移到保险库,然后从 .env 删除这些明文密钥,最后重新构建并重启 NanoClaw 服务。
howto.when: 当你要求运行 /init-onecli,或是在 /update-nanoclaw 引入 OneCLI 后、或首次设置 OneCLI 时触发。

say.text: 运行 /init-onecli 把 .env 密钥迁入 Agent Vault。
say.note: Claude 会安装 OneCLI 并迁移凭据。

say.text: 我要让 OneCLI 管理我的 Anthropic 密钥。
NanoClaw 更新后,帮我初始化 OneCLI。
say.note: 会检查代码并安装、配置 OneCLI 网关。

howto.what_en: Claude installs OneCLI, configures the Agent Vault gateway, migrates existing .env API keys into the vault, removes those plaintext keys from .env, then rebuilds and restarts the NanoClaw service.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to run /init-onecli, after /update-nanoclaw introduces OneCLI, or for first-time OneCLI setup.

say_en.text: Run /init-onecli to migrate .env keys into the Agent Vault.
say_en.note: Claude installs OneCLI and moves credentials.

say_en.text: I want OneCLI to manage my Anthropic key.
say_en.note: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and similar are removed from .env.

say_en.text: Set up OneCLI after the NanoClaw update.
say_en.note: Claude checks the codebase, installs, and configures the gateway.
